author: Anu
content:
There was a girl "mona" in my class back in school... She'd sit right in front of me and never talk to anyone. I kept asking her why she didn't talk to anyone in class.. She said she just didn't feel like it. People thought she was arrogant and proud, she looked like that. As I got to know her, in a months time, I realised she was completely different than what people perceived of her, and we became the BEST of friends..!  :smile:
Appearances are always deceptive.. good luck !  :smile:
